name: Organization Members
description: The owner of the org-admin tool pack. It holds the tools of the Members tab of Organisation: list the members and the sign-in requests that wait, set the roles of a member, suspend or reactivate a member, and approve or deny a sign-in request. Each change shows one card first. Each tool calls the admin routes as the member, and the routes decide each right. The main assistant loads these tools in a turn about the members. This agent is not a second assistant, and a hand-off to it is refused.
author: Metorite
